description: This file defines a Jetpack Compose UI component 'RepoDetailsContent' for displaying repository details in the FDroid app, including progress indicators, mirrors, and settings.

classes.name: RepoDetailsContent

classes.description: A composable function for previewing the RepoDetailsContent UI in the IDE.
